results.description:
MyRecipes is the easiest way to save, organize, and cook the recipes you love. Trusted by millions of home cooks with over 75 million recipe saves—and counting. Enjoy the app for free or upgrade to a MyRecipes+ membership for more ways to save and exclusive premium features. 

- Save recipes from anywhere
- Includes 100,000+ trusted recipes
- Built for effortless cooking
- Stay organized
- Get personalized recommendations
- Upgrade to MyRecipes+ (no ads, save from Instagram & TikTok, and more!)

Spend less time searching and more time enjoying great food. MyRecipes gives you personalized recommendations, collections to keep you organized, and simplifies the cooking experience on any screen. Already have a MyRecipes account? Just sign in to the app and all your saved recipes and custom collections will be there waiting for you.

SAVE RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE
Stop sending recipe links to yourself and scrolling through your browser history. MyRecipes makes it easy to save recipes from thousands of your favorite food sites for free. Upgrade to a MyRecipes+ membership to save from Instagram and TikTok, too.. Keep everything organized in one place. No more digging through screenshots, bookmarks, or endless saved posts.

INCLUDES 100,000+ TRUSTED RECIPES
Explore more than 100,000 recipes from the trusted brands you know and love, including Allrecipes, Food & Wine, EatingWell, Southern Living, Serious Eats, Simply Recipes, Spruce Eats, Better Homes & Gardens, Real Simple, and Liquor.com.

Every recipe is tested by culinary experts and reviewed by home cooks, so whether you’re trying something new or returning to an old favorite, you can count on great results. From healthy meals and family favorites to baking projects and holiday classics, you'll find recipes for every craving, occasion, and cooking style.

BUILT FOR EFFORTLESS COOKING
MyRecipes is designed for cooking from your iPhone and iPad. Recipes open in a clean, clutter-free “cook mode” built for step-by-step cooking. 

- Screen stays awake while you cook
- Easily switch between ingredients and directions with a tap
- No browser tabs or losing your place halfway through a recipe

STAY ORGANIZED
Spend less time searching for saved recipes. Create collections to organize your favorites for every cooking moment:

- This week’s meal plan
- Healthy go-tos
- Holiday menus
- Kid-approved picks
- Recipes to try next

Find a Featured Collection from our editors that you love? Turn it into a personal collection with a tap, then customize it to make it your own. 

With the MyRecipes app, save the recipes you love, organize them your way, and find them instantly when it’s time to cook.

GET PERSONALIZED RECOMMENDATIONS
The more you save, the more MyRecipes learns what you love to cook. Get personalized recommendations based on your tastes, favorite cuisines, and cooking habits, discover new favorites and unexpected ideas, then save the recipes that inspire you for later.

Looking for a quick weeknight dinner? A crowd-pleasing dessert? Planning your holiday menu? Search across your entire recipe collection with ease. Filter by cook time, rating, ingredients, brand, and more to quickly find exactly what you’re looking for.

UPGRADE TO MYRECIPES+
Get even more with a MyRecipes+ membership. Start with a 7-day FREE trial to unlock:

- Ad-free mode  
- Save recipes from Instagram and TikTok
- Even more personalized recommendations  
- Exclusive updates from our editors
- Special members discounts 

Recipe inspiration is everywhere. MyRecipes brings the best all together in one place.
